title: 155. Majority Element

examples.explanation: 3 appears 2 times out of 3, which is more than 3/2 = 1.
2 appears 4 times out of 7, which is more than 7/2 = 3.

hints: The Boyer-Moore voting algorithm finds the majority in O(n) time and O(1) space: keep a candidate and count, incrementing on match and decrementing otherwise.
Alternatively, sorting puts the majority element at index n/2, or a hash map can count frequencies.
